title: Synthesis of benzimidazoles from o-phenylenediamines with α-keto acids via amino acid catalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36803-36807
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06371J, Paper

Zhenbiao Luo, Mulin Huang, Xiangyong Wang, Xinye Wang, Zhihui Hu, Liang Zhao, Ting Huang
A green and simple method for the synthesis of benzimidazoles by amino acid catalysis of o-phenylenediamines with α-keto acids has been developed.
